svg.title: Four queue tickets refer to the same seasonal worker, but the system recognises no claimant.
svg.desc: The indigo-and-cream travel bundle confirms that this is the worker from page 34. Riju fans out four differently coloured tickets beside the documents; four variant record trays wait, yet the claimant indicator remains dark.
svg.text: Page 35, panel 1 · Straight-on queue-counter tableau with four ticket dispensers

text.tspan: The system issues four turns to the same citizen

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
